plugins.description: AI-Native IC Design plugin for Claude Code. One install bundles and auto-registers the MCP-EDA server (open-source EDA tools + lab hardware). Two entry points (NL prompt OR design docs) → one Phase 1 → layered design JSON → RTL → FPGA SOF + ASIC GDS; Analog A1-A9 + Mixed-signal M1-M4 interleaved. Strict canonical-flow compliance gate plus anti-fabrication doctrine (provenance audit-chain, chip-AGNOSTIC source guard, real-artifact/SHA256 attestation, benchmark-path consistency) — no fabrication, no hallucinated PASS.
